data.one_liner: An animated bottom navigation bar with customizable parameters and a dome effect.
data.what_it_does: Provides an animated bottom navigation bar widget called MoltenBottomNavigationBar. It allows developers to configure tab items, colors, heights, and dome animation curves for selecting tabs.
use_when: You want an animated bottom navigation bar with a dome style effect
You need a customizable bottom navigation bar layout with high visual tweaks
avoid_when: You need a standard Material Design BottomNavigationBar without custom animations
You are implementing complex nested navigation routes that require a full navigation solution
strengths: Highly customizable bar and dome attributes
Built-in smooth animations for tab selection
weaknesses: Limited documentation on some advanced attributes
Relies on a single-purpose widget layout
